Recharge accuracy results (2026-11-07). Errors are in seconds of capture time from frames.csv (the recordings
average about 45 FPS with gaps up to 0.1 s), with frame counts of the recording's own index in brackets.

A cycle whose start bar comes within 3 s of a mid-recording startup may have been used before it; not measuring it
is scored as correct ("SKIPPED"), never as a false start.

Mid-recharge estimates (tracking picked up a running recharge; marked Estimated, never saved to history)
|estimated total - annotated total| by share of the cycle observed, mean/max seconds (n):
Recording  10-25%            25-50%             50-75%             75-100%
123051     -                 0.428/1.160 (24)   0.348/0.887 (27)   0.355/0.934 (25)
124028     0.881 (2)         0.420/2.038 (16)   0.136/0.351 (14)   0.072/0.139 (18)
153154     0.661/0.686 (2)   0.488/4.330 (26)   0.026/0.066 (25)   0.096/0.287 (20)
162021     0.270/0.339 (2)   0.145/0.423 (32)   0.031/0.087 (40)   0.036/0.087 (26)
All 299: median 0.068 s, mean 0.214 s, 90th percentile 0.63 s, max 4.33 s. Estimates are dropped (nothing reported)
when under 10% of the bar was seen or the start's uncertainty exceeds 5% of the cycle.
Linearity: across 25 fully observed cycles, calibrated progress tracks elapsed share within about 0.01 at every
decile (raw progress = elapsed share - 0.026 ... -0.013), so a straight line is the right model. Offline on the same
fixtures, the best estimator (observed end minus the fitted line's zero) gives 0.07 s mean at 50-75% observed.

Root causes
- Start bar against bright scenes (153154 class2 -52 fr, 162021 grenade3 +9 fr): a fixed 0.15 contrast test. Now bar
  opacity relative to the slot just above it: (peak - background) / (0.9 - background), row medians, narrow shape.
- Use pulses before the real bar (124028 class1/2, 153154 class3): one re-arm after a 0.25 s dip. Now every
  threshold crossing or clear step up (0.12) in bar opacity within 1.5 s is a candidate, and the fitted progress
  line's zero chooses; the 0.25 s dip rule is no longer used for real pixel signals.
- 123051 melee3 +26 fr: a use flash was ignored after a bright scene washed out the ready look.
- Startup: colours learned from scenery let blank frames or white scenery read as uses, long before any bar, and
  completed recharges early. Uses expire after 4 s; use flashes longer than 0.45 s (or flickering) are scenery;
  blank-as-use needs a ready colour a use confirmed; charged looks cannot complete a recharge while the fitted line
  says the bar is far from full, nor within 3 s of a start; at the line's full time any charged colour is accepted
  (and the gray-bar end is then required).
- Mid-recharge borders: the gray bar's boundary is read as the bottom border early in a recharge, biasing progress
  by about 0.1. Borders are now the densest 1-px cluster of the last ~30 s of readings, and an estimated cycle is
  refitted from its raw boundary rows with the final borders.
- 162021 frames 1-20: 19 byte-identical frames about 34 ms apart, then about 17 ms apart: the GDI fallback returns a
  stale image until desktop duplication delivers its first frame. The recorder now skips frames until the first
  newly presented one (2 s limit for GDI-only capture).

Thresholds: values and margins across all four recordings
- Bar opacity on/off 0.5/0.4: annotated start frames 0.52-0.65; thin border 0.13-0.22; use-pulse decay up to 0.49.
  With step candidates, full replays are exact for any threshold in 0.45-0.50 (0.40 and 0.55 fail); the sweep
  prefers 0.50 (0.47 lets one scenery edge in 124028 start a recharge).
- Bar luminance 0.9, measured on dark backgrounds. Bar width at most max(4, 8% of height) rows: bars 2-4, flashes 14-15.
- Use flash at most 0.45 s: real use flashes 0.03-0.31 s; a white scene lasted 0.6 s.
- Use-to-bar limit 4 s: real delays 0.24-2.58 s (per recording max 2.58/1.89/1.44/1.45); stale uses were 8 and 18 s old.
- Charged run before a use flash 0.3 s (0.1 s added 11 failing sessions). Minimum recharge 3 s (shortest real 27 s).
Leave-one-recording-out: bar opacity - the range allowed by any three recordings (0.45-0.50) contains a value that
passes the fourth (all four pass at 0.45 and 0.50). Use-to-bar limit - twice the maximum of any three (>= 3.8 s)
covers the fourth. Use flash - 1.5x the maximum of any three (>= 0.42 s) covers 0.31 s.
